# Manga MVP fixtures and offline demo

`sample-page-ja.png` is the supplied synthetic Japanese test page. No user screenshots are used in tests.

`out-before.png` and `out-after.png` are generated by `scripts/manga-browser-check.mjs` from that fixture with hand-annotated bubble boxes. The production `mangaDraw` function performs white-region checks, erasure, fitting and text rendering. **No vision API was called.** These demonstrate rendering, not OCR accuracy.

Run the mandatory keyless suite:

```sh
node scripts/ci-check.mjs
```

Optional browser check and regenerate images (dependencies stay outside the repository):

```sh
npm install --prefix /tmp/manga-browser-tools playwright-core --no-audit --no-fund
PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/tmp/manga-browser-tools/node_modules/playwright-core/index.mjs node scripts/manga-browser-check.mjs
```

Set `CHROME_PATH` if Chrome is not `/usr/bin/google-chrome`. This check mocks the extension runtime and vision response, while using real mouse drags/clicks, canvas cropping and production rendering. It verifies hidden capture overlays, zero requests before confirmation or after cancellation, one crop upload, reversible toggle and ignored late replies. It is not an unpacked-extension end-to-end API test.

## Try the extension

Load the repository root unpacked. Configure a DeepSeek key in settings (the manga action always uses DeepSeek, even if text translation uses Kimi). Open the popup's **更多 → 框选翻译漫画（DeepSeek）**, drag a visible region, inspect its local preview, then confirm **翻译选区**. Cancel/Escape sends no image. Use **原图 / 译图** to switch reversibly; **更多** on the result offers download. Existing **翻译此页** remains the text/YouTube path.

## Limits

- Only the current visible tab region is captured. No chapter fetching or page scraping.
- OCR/bbox quality from DeepSeek is unverified by this offline suite. Confidence >= 0.9, plausible pixel bounds, mostly white pixels and a white perimeter are required; uncertain/nonwhite, overlapping or overflowing text regions retain their original pixels. A white-fill heuristic cannot guarantee perfect art preservation; inspect the reversible result.
- Scroll/resize/navigation withdraw the current selection/result. Reader-internal page flips (including Jump+), zoom implementations and canvas readers have limited compatibility; there is no reliable automatic page-turn detector. Trigger a new selection after a flip; it immediately removes the previous result.
- Results are held in an eight-entry, in-memory OCR cache keyed by SHA-256 of the cropped image plus viewport/layout/URL and target language. Worker restart clears it. Invalid/failed/aborted responses are not cached. Layout or crop changes prevent reuse.
- Max 16 megapixels / roughly 12 MB PNG crop; 60-second request deadline. Conservative rendering may replace zero bubbles and report that originals were retained.
- Active-tab capture cannot run on restricted browser pages. Permissions, API hosts and extension version are unchanged; no persistent content scripts or generative artwork requests are added.
